snippet.title: Loulan: The Cursed Sand Game Reveal Trailer | PC & PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Loulan: The Cursed Sand is an action RPG set along the ancient Silk Road in the Western Regions of China. You play as the Cursed Sand, a skeletal warrior wielding the power of sand to explore the lost kingdom of Loulan, battle mighty foes, and seek your beloved princess.
Wishlist it if you're interested! 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833280 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/loulan-the-cursed-sand-60d275
